_meta.what_this_is: A generated-media provenance fixture. 'produced' is the set of assets a pipeline generated, each with a name and its bytes (short strings standing in for image/video bytes). 'delivered' is what actually arrived to be verified against the manifest -- identical to produced except scanner.png was SWAPPED: its bytes changed while its name stayed the same. 'collision' is two genuinely different assets that happen to share a name. A name-based id verifies the swap as genuine and collides the two; a content hash catches both.
_meta.bytes_are: Short text stand-ins for real media bytes. hashlib treats them identically to image bytes; the provenance logic does not care.
_meta.format: produced/delivered [{name, bytes}]; collision [two assets with the same name]
